chapterInfo.content:
12
Ɔbaa no ne Ɔtweaseɛ no
1Na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ kɛseɛ bi yii ne ho adi ɔsoro. Ɔbaa bi a ɔfira owia, na ɔsrane wɔ ne nan aseɛ, na nsoromma dummienu abotire bobɔ ne tire 2#Mika 4.10 na wafa afuro, na ɔretea mu reko awoɔ, na awoɔ aden no.
3 # Adi 12.9 Na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ foforɔ yii ne ho adi wɔ ɔsoro, na hwɛ, ɔtweaseɛ kakraka kɔkɔɔ a ɔwɔ tire nson ne mmɛn du, na ahemmotire nson bobɔ ne ti. 4#Dan 8.10 Na ɔde ne dua twee ɔsoro nsoromma nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako, na ɔtoto guu asase so. Na ɔtweaseɛ no bɛgyinaa ɔbaa a ɔrebɛwoɔ no anim, na sɛ ɔwo a, wamene ne ba no. 5#Dwom 2.9; Adi 19.15 Na ɔwoo ɔbabanin a ɔde dadeɛ poma bɛdi amanaman nyinaa so. Na wɔfaa ne ba no de no kɔɔ Nyankopɔn ne n’ahennwa no nkyɛn. 6#Mat 2.13; Adi 11.2-3 Na ɔbaa no dwane kɔɔ ɛserɛ so, deɛ Onyankopɔn asiesie baabi ama no sɛ wɔnhwɛ no hɔ nna apem ahanu aduosia.
Mikael di ɔtweaseɛ no so nkonim
7 # Dan 10.13; 10.21; 12.1 Na ɔko baa ɔsoro. Mikael ne n’abɔfoɔ tuu ɔtweaseɛ no so sa ne no koe. Na ɔtweaseɛ no ne n’abɔfoɔ koe. 8Na wɔdii wɔn so, na wɔannya kwan ɔsoro bio. 9#Luk 10.18; Yoh 12.31; Gye 3.1; 3.14 Na wɔtuu ɔtweaseɛ kɛseɛ no, ɔwɔ dada no a wɔfrɛ no Ɔbonsam ne Satan, deɛ ɔdaadaa amanaman nyinaa no, firii hɔ too no twenee asase so, na wɔtoo n’abɔfoɔ kaa ne ho gui.
10 # Adi 11.15; Hiob 1.11; Sak 3.1; Luk 22.31 Na metee nne kɛseɛ ɔsoro sɛ:
Afei nkwagyeɛ ne tumi
ne ahennie ayɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn dea,
na tumi ayɛ ne Kristo no dea,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔato yɛn nuanom anototofoɔ no atwene;
ɔno na ɔtoto wɔn ano yɛn Nyankopɔn anim awia ne anadwo.
11 # Adi 7.14; 12.17; Rom 8.37 Na wɔnam Adwammaa no mogya
ne wɔn adanseɛ asɛm no so adi ne so nkonim,
na wɔansuro sɛ wɔbɛwuo.
12Yei nti, ɔsoro
ne mo a motete mu no,
momma mo bo ntɔ mo yam.
Asase ne ɛpo nnue,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔbonsam asiane aba mo nkyɛn,
na wafa abufuo kɛse,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔnim sɛ ne berɛ a ɔwɔ yɛ tia.
Ɔtweaseɛ no tu sa bio wɔ asase so
13Na ɔtweaseɛ no hunuu sɛ wɔato no atwene asase soɔ no, ɔtaa ɔbaa a ɔwoo ɔbabanin no. 14#Adi 12.6; Dan 7.25; 12.7 Na wɔmaa ɔbaa no ɔkɔdeɛ kɛseɛ no ntaban mmienu sɛ ɔmfa ntu nkɔ ɛserɛ so wɔ ne tenaberɛ, deɛ wɔbɛhwɛ no ɛberɛ ne mmerɛ ne berɛ fa afiri ɔwɔ no anim. 15Na ɔwɔ no puu n’anomu nsuo te sɛ asubɔnten guu ɔbaa no akyi, sɛ anka ɛmfa no. 16Nanso asase boaa ɔbaa no, na asase buee n’anomu menee asubɔnten a ɔtweaseɛ no pu firii n’anomu no. 17#Adi 14.12; 19.10; 1 Yoh 5.10 Na ɔtweaseɛ no bo fuu ɔbaa no, na ɔkɔtuu n’asefoɔ nkaeɛ a wɔdi Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ soɔ na wɔkura Yesu Kristo adanseɛ no so sa.
18Na ɔkɔgyinaa mpoano anwea so.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ kɛseɛ bi yii ne ho adi ɔsoro. Ɔbaa bi a ɔfira owia, na ɔsrane wɔ ne nan aseɛ, na nsoromma dummienu abotire bobɔ ne tire na wafa afuro, na ɔretea mu reko awoɔ, na awoɔ aden no.
Na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ foforɔ yii ne ho adi wɔ ɔsoro, na hwɛ, ɔtweaseɛ kakraka kɔkɔɔ a ɔwɔ tire nson ne mmɛn du, na ahemmotire nson bobɔ ne ti. Na ɔde ne dua twee ɔsoro nsoromma nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako, na ɔtoto guu asase so. Na ɔtweaseɛ no bɛgyinaa ɔbaa a ɔrebɛwoɔ no anim, na sɛ ɔwo a, wamene ne ba no. Na ɔwoo ɔbabanin a ɔde dadeɛ poma bɛdi amanaman nyinaa so. Na wɔfaa ne ba no de no kɔɔ Nyankopɔn ne n’ahennwa no nkyɛn. Na ɔbaa no dwane kɔɔ ɛserɛ so, deɛ Onyankopɔn asiesie baabi ama no sɛ wɔnhwɛ no hɔ nna apem ahanu aduosia.

Na ɔko baa ɔsoro. Mikael ne n’abɔfoɔ tuu ɔtweaseɛ no so sa ne no koe. Na ɔtweaseɛ no ne n’abɔfoɔ koe. Na wɔdii wɔn so, na wɔannya kwan ɔsoro bio. Na wɔtuu ɔtweaseɛ kɛseɛ no, ɔwɔ dada no a wɔfrɛ no Ɔbonsam ne Satan, deɛ ɔdaadaa amanaman nyinaa no, firii hɔ too no twenee asase so, na wɔtoo n’abɔfoɔ kaa ne ho gui.
Na metee nne kɛseɛ ɔsoro sɛ:
Afei nkwagyeɛ ne tumi
ne ahennie ayɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn dea,
na tumi ayɛ ne Kristo no dea,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔato yɛn nuanom anototofoɔ no atwene;
ɔno na ɔtoto wɔn ano yɛn Nyankopɔn anim awia ne anadwo.
Na wɔnam Adwammaa no mogya
ne wɔn adanseɛ asɛm no so adi ne so nkonim,
na wɔansuro sɛ wɔbɛwuo.
Yei nti, ɔsoro
ne mo a motete mu no,
momma mo bo ntɔ mo yam.
Asase ne ɛpo nnue,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔbonsam asiane aba mo nkyɛn,
na wafa abufuo kɛse,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔnim sɛ ne berɛ a ɔwɔ yɛ tia.

Na ɔtweaseɛ no hunuu sɛ wɔato no atwene asase soɔ no, ɔtaa ɔbaa a ɔwoo ɔbabanin no. Na wɔmaa ɔbaa no ɔkɔdeɛ kɛseɛ no ntaban mmienu sɛ ɔmfa ntu nkɔ ɛserɛ so wɔ ne tenaberɛ, deɛ wɔbɛhwɛ no ɛberɛ ne mmerɛ ne berɛ fa afiri ɔwɔ no anim. Na ɔwɔ no puu n’anomu nsuo te sɛ asubɔnten guu ɔbaa no akyi, sɛ anka ɛmfa no. Nanso asase boaa ɔbaa no, na asase buee n’anomu menee asubɔnten a ɔtweaseɛ no pu firii n’anomu no. Na ɔtweaseɛ no bo fuu ɔbaa no, na ɔkɔtuu n’asefoɔ nkaeɛ a wɔdi Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ soɔ na wɔkura Yesu Kristo adanseɛ no so sa.
Na ɔkɔgyinaa mpoano anwea so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
